title: The Bunker Springs
physical_identity: A tiny limestone cave hot spring (about 18.6 m2) with two waterfalls; warm potable mineral water; no life of any kind.
scale_topology: Finite, one small indoor cave; the page says it is the only part of the level left.
anomalies: cave behind exit tunnel reportedly lies on a Stormstone plain (testimony)
lighting_sound: Not stated; humid air, waterfalls implied by two small waterfalls feeding the pool.
hazards: over two hours bathing causes dizziness and nausea
other waterfall tunnel leads to nowhere (testimony: Stormstone plain)

entrances.method: most popular way; arrives at tunnel entrance, descend staircase
entrances.quote: This will always bring you to the tunnel entrance

entrances.method: hottest setting, close your eyes inside
entrances.quote: turning a functional shower or bath to its hottest setting and closing your eyes

exits.method: M.E.G. stairway and walk the tunnel with the stream
exits.quote: back into the same location you entered it from

exits.method: climb the other waterfall tunnel, crawl through to a Stormstone plain, step forward (log)
exits.conditions: testimony; page says do not climb
exits.quote: Don't climb the other waterfall tunnel. It leads to nowhere.

signature_mechanic: Safe warm spring with bathing timer (benefits after 1 h, nausea after 2 h); hidden twist exit via the second waterfall into a Stormstone wasteland.
verticality: Low; optional cliff climb to the second waterfall opening; stairway to the tunnel.
do_not: treat Stormstone plain as safe level
conflicts_notes: Page says the spring houses all entrances and all but one exit; the 'one exit' is the other tunnel leading to nowhere (log says Stormstone Keep). Page flagged outdated.

key_quotes.quote: approximately 200 square feet (18.6 square meters) hot spring
It was the only part of the level left.
Don't climb the other waterfall tunnel. It leads to nowhere.
